method: Same pinned Silk toolchain and release shell, --jit --jit-calls --jit-stats. Differential Callgrind Ir for 800/1600 outer passes divided by 800000 extra updates. See ../reproduce.sh and fixed.sh. Original 10000-pass fixed-work checksum 12486251. Timing (when present) lives in wall.json, nine interleaved rounds.
limits: Monomorphic unshared Float64Array. Load sole numeric unbox use with borrowed source, store sole use of a BoxF64. Rechecks class, payload, shared flag, length, and reloads the data pointer on every access. Guard miss resumes before the original operation. Inlined frames and OSR without element feedback keep previous lowering.
